actual: backend/routers/external_research.py defaults to DeterministicExternalResearchProvider; no real network-capable provider is wired behind an opt-in env gate, so RA external_research cannot query current web or papers.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description:
backend/routers/external_research.py defaults to DeterministicExternalResearchProvider; no real network-capable provider is wired behind an opt-in env gate, so RA external_research cannot query current web or papers.

Scope expanded for real opt-in provider implementation: AgentSearch web/extract, Semantic Scholar/arXiv papers, offline default fallback, docs/deploy artifacts, and httpx-mocked tests.

events.note: Expanded allowed_write_scope for RA real external research provider; production_backend_dependency_gate=pending for trafilatura local extraction fallback.
Added backend dependency manifests to allowed_write_scope for httpx/trafilatura production install gate.
Local trafilatura fallback is SSRF-guarded; RA_LOCAL_EXTRACT_ALLOWED_HOSTS defaults empty and must list approved public hosts before direct local fetch_extract fallback is used.

expected: With RA_EXTERNAL_RESEARCH_PROVIDER=real and RA_AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL configured, RA external_research uses AgentSearch for web/extract and Semantic Scholar/arXiv for papers; default offline remains deterministic stub; all network failures return empty results with explicit reason_code and no fabricated evidence.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
production_backend_dependency_note: trafilatura==2.1.0 is required for the local fetch_extract fallback when RA_EXTERNAL_RESEARCH_PROVIDER=real; httpx==0.28.1 and trafilatura==2.1.0 are pinned in backend/requirements.txt for production backend installs. RA_LOCAL_EXTRACT_ALLOWED_HOSTS defaults empty; set explicit public hosts only if using the local trafilatura fallback.
reproduce_command: Call /api/v1/external-research/search-web or search-papers in current default runtime; results are deterministic offline/stub data and never hit real providers.
title: RA External Research provider is deterministic offline stub instead of real web and paper search

recommendations: Use compact success output; request full JSON only for failures or diagnostics.
Run targeted validation first, then final gates once the patch is stable.
